focusRegression.method: Running production WEB, real touch/keyboard/buttons and original bundled pages; simulated insets, not native-device QA

localized.label: Mở khóa · Chế độ tập trung
Mở khóa · Chế độ tập trung

validationNotes: Per-visible-glyph checks exposed a genuinely truncated French Share App toolbar title at 280px. The opt-in wrapping toolbar now applies only to Share App; default toolbars retain their original single-line geometry. The final all-language run retained and passed the strict glyph checks.

A preliminary persistence test transferring complete application storage into a fresh HTTP-cache context observed three aborted background requests. Their root cause was not established. The final persistence test models the intended normal browser lifecycle: one-time initial test preference storage, a real Settings language choice and a same-profile reload, with no per-load re-seeding. No networking runtime was changed or claimed fixed, and all request-error assertions remain strict; the final 24 Share/settings contexts have empty error arrays.

The initial new unit tests had overly literal Arabic definite-article matching and a minimum character count inappropriate for concise Chinese. Those assertions were corrected to match the actual localized phrasing and retain language-specific dedication topic checks. The final entire 252-test suite passed.

The comprehensive 548-page offline sweep and instrumented pinch/audio R104 checks were not rerun for this copy-only revision. Their historical evidence, original reader sources, original font and supplied resources are unchanged. The full existing Focus browser regression was rerun on the current bundle and passed.
limitations: Production Expo web/Chromium screenshots and native Hermes exports are not installed Android/iOS device, screen-reader, OS share-sheet, hardware gesture or real-camera QA.

Web Share outcomes use explicit browser bridge doubles. One EN clipboard success uses the actual browser clipboard; its denial case and all-language repeated copied/error statuses use explicit clipboard doubles, not a browser permission dialog. No recipient-delivery claim is made.
Google Play navigation is intercepted only in QA and verifies the exact destination, not listing availability or a published release.
All-language authored copy and rendered coverage are not professional linguistic review.
No deployment, store submission, new runtime dependency, generated artwork, user-data migration/deletion, Tajweed or Mufahras implementation is included.
